mods.name: FMod
mods.description: Stash hunting, route and flight helpers, coordinate hiding, and utilities for Meteor Client.

releases.notes:
FMod v0.4.0 targets Minecraft 26.3, Meteor 26.3, and Java 25.

### Stash Mover

- Choose a source return by `/kill`, a marked redstone trap button, or a second stasis chamber.
- Use ReturnPearl for two-way stasis on default vanilla servers. A trap-button return can be paired with stasis when the server preserves the courier's pearls on death.
- Follow the [illustrated setup guide](https://github.com/fluffysnaff/fmod/blob/v0.4.0/README.md#stash-mover-setup) and complete two empty round trips before moving cargo.

### Modules and commands

- Added EventlessFly, KnockbackTweaks, and SeedMap. FrameDupe checks the frame contents before placing or attacking.
- Renamed FMod's Speed module to SpeedBypass. Removed Base Scout and `.clubmate`.
- Added the stash map, VolytraFly control for Search Area routes, and improved flight near the loaded-chunk boundary.
- Added InfReach, AntiMapCrash, NoFpsThrottle, and `.fvclip`. Updated the shared movement helper used by the clip and teleport commands.

Install `fmod-0.4.0.jar` in your Fabric profile's `mods` folder. The checksum is in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

### Known issue

With Baritone 26.3-SNAPSHOT installed, earlier and current test runs reached Minecraft's shutdown watchdog after the gameplay checks passed. The base configuration exited cleanly.

releases.notes:
FMod 0.3.0 for **Minecraft 26.3**, **Meteor Client 26.3-SNAPSHOT**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**, and **Java 25+**.

Download `fmod-0.3.0.jar` and place it in your Fabric profile's `mods` folder alongside Meteor Client. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains its checksum.

### Changes since 0.2.0

- Add BaseScout, container tracking/indexing and shulker tools, stash-moving controls, travel monitoring, sign tools, pearl operations, and the DubCounter HUD.
- Add VolytraFly with navigation and HUD support, improved recovery near Nether walls, and local Autonav diagnostic snapshots/logs.
- Add UI Utils with saved container screens, bounded delayed-click queues, an in-game packet editor, inventory chat fields, and optional resource-pack bypass controls.
- Let TrailFollower use either Meteor ElytraFly or normal Meteor Flight, preserving controller settings and releasing owned input on stop.
- Add a default-on unloaded-chunk guard to Meteor Flight that pauses horizontal movement and resumes when chunks arrive.
- Add coherent randomized coordinate displays alongside Hide mode. This affects supported displays only; exports, packets, route data and configured webhook contents retain real coordinates.

### Compatibility and validation

- Xaero's maps, XaeroPlus and Baritone remain optional. Modules that need them are registered only when their requirements are installed; see the [feature guide](https://github.com/fluffysnaff/fmod/blob/v0.3.0/docs/FEATURES.md).
- Built from a clean source export with Java 25; all 94 unit tests passed, with no skipped tests. Packaged metadata, mixin classes, assets and license notices were checked.
- Earlier isolated development-client checks exercised UI Utils (47 assertions), TrailFollower flight integration (32 assertions), and the Flight chunk guard (24 assertions). The TrailFollower run passed its assertions but hit a Baritone worker shutdown watchdog afterward. Multiplayer server behavior is not verified.
- Existing source-permission caveats for the stashhunting port remain documented in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/fluffysnaff/fmod/blob/v0.3.0/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

[Full comparison](https://github.com/fluffysnaff/fmod/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0)

releases.notes:
FMod 0.2.0 is a **prerelease for Minecraft 26.3 and Meteor Client 26.3**. It is a different feature set from the legacy v1.1.1 release.

## Changes

- Ported FMod to Minecraft/Meteor 26.3, Java 25, and the current Mojang-named APIs.
- Added 18 stashhunting modules and the Weather and EntityList HUD elements from the stashhunting addon: stash detection and exports, old-chunk alerts, trail following and plotting, rectangle/spiral searches, flight helpers, inventory indexing, and utility modules.
- Added `coord-hider` for F3 location entries, Meteor coordinate HUD templates, and coordinate text.
- Removed TpMine, LiveWalk, InstaMine, InfReach, FrozenWalk, and their dedicated hooks and HUD. Teleport and clip commands remain available.
- Added bounded background webhook delivery and fixed several startup, path-mode ownership, and inventory-response issues in the port.
- Set GPL-3.0-only as FMod's primary license, retained attribution and provenance notices, and refreshed the documentation and logo.

## Install

1. Use **Minecraft 26.3**, **Meteor Client for 26.3**, **Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer**, and **Java 25 or newer**.
2. Download **`fmod-0.2.0.jar`** below and place it alongside Meteor in your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
3. Open Meteor's menu and select the **FMod** category. Commands use Meteor's configured prefix (`.` by default).

Map and trail integrations require the corresponding optional Xaero and/or Meteor Baritone mods. These mods are not bundled. See [optional dependencies and tested versions](https://github.com/fluffysnaff/fmod/blob/v0.2.0/docs/FEATURES.md#optional-mods).

## Validation and limitations

- Built from a clean checkout; all 5 unit tests passed.
- The actual packaged JAR passed startup and runtime assertions with optional mods absent and with Xaero's maps, XaeroPlus, and Baritone installed.
- Multiplayer gameplay and server-specific exploits have **not** been verified; this is a prerelease, not a guarantee of compatibility with a particular server.
- Coordinate hiding affects on-screen text only. Maps, world geometry, packets, exports, logs, clipboard contents, and configured webhook messages can retain real coordinates. Unrecognised third-party overlay/text formats can also remain visible.
- The imported stashhunting revision has no published license file. FMod's GPL declaration does not resolve that upstream permission issue. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/fluffysnaff/fmod/blob/v0.2.0/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for provenance and redistribution limitations.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the SHA-256 checksum for the JAR. Source for this release is available through the `v0.2.0` tag and GitHub's source archives below.
